# partiteai_mesh_version_label (Resource)

Labels a mesh version. Creating the resource freezes the mesh's current draft under `label`, and the mesh gets a new draft with the same configuration. The resource then follows that version by its ID.

* A change to `label` renames that version. It does not freeze a new version. To freeze a new version, add a resource at a new address.
* To move a baseline, replace the resource block with a block at a new address in one apply. The apply removes the old label and freezes the draft under the new label. The old version stays frozen.
* Destroying the resource removes the label. The version stays frozen, with its conversations and evaluation runs. To keep the label, remove the resource with a `removed` block that has `lifecycle { destroy = false }`. If you apply the same configuration again, the resource freezes the current draft. It does not take back the old version.
* Labeling must happen after the configuration that it freezes. Add `depends_on` for the mesh's `partiteai_mesh_input` and `partiteai_mesh_link` resources, and for anything else that changes the draft.
* A frozen version keeps references to the agent versions it uses, so an agent cannot be deleted while a frozen version of its mesh exists. Add `depends_on` for the mesh's agents to the `partiteai_mesh` resource, so that a destroy deletes the mesh first.
* Do not change a label resource and the mesh configuration in the same apply. The label waits for the configuration, so it freezes the changed configuration.
* If one apply adds two label resources for the same mesh, both freeze the same configuration.
* A webhook destination or a schedule that names a removed or renamed label fails on its next use.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) The label. A change renames the version.
- `mesh_id` (String) The ID of the mesh. A change replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the labeled mesh version.
- `mesh_version_id` (String) The ID of the labeled mesh version. This is the same value as `id`.
- `ordinal` (Number) The ordinal of the labeled mesh version.
